versions.changelog: Security hardening (2.2.1): pin lxml>=6.1.0 to fix CVE-2026-41066 (XXE); add secure lxml parser with entity resolution disabled for .wdx/.opju; fully disclose sidecar metadata & backup file writes in manifest.
优化用户菜单(UI)与 README，碳基生物用户使用时更方便；并修复 CSV 分隔符探测、.tsv 读取、UTF-16 编码、XPT 读取报错、长变量标签静默截断告警等健壮性 bug。

Standardized bilingual (en/zh) formatting per 2026-07-17 policy: non-table separators use '/', Core Capabilities table merged, README_ZH aligned; plus security hardening (allow_r_exec gate, dependency pins).

security: harden R deserialization (allow_r_exec gate), declare side effects in description, back up .hyper before overwrite, add Security sections; addresses 6 SkillSpector findings (Tp4 High, RCE High, Lp3, 2x Medium, Low)
security: fix Tp4 overclaim + FST format misidentification; FST now detect-only
docs: bilingual refactor (en-first), slim SKILL.md, fix writer.py XPT crash
v2.0.0 major release: 50+ formats, Excel/MATLAB/Parquet/HDF5/twbx Access fixes
v2.0.0: README 限制修复 + 三真实文件验证 (Excel 合并/MATLAB v7.3/Parquet 分区/HDF5 属性/twbx 内嵌 Access/Access table_name)
v1.9.0: add Tableau Hyper (.hyper) read/write and .twbx packaged-workbook unpack read; statdata_meta side-table preserves variable/value labels; lazy-imported, no impact on other formats

v1.8.4 security fixes: eliminate remaining R-bridge command injection in Minitab(.mtw)/EpiData(.rec) readers and writer — all R bridges now use static scripts with argv params (jsonlite-parsed), no user input interpolated into R code; fix missing _parse_value_labels import

v1.8.3 security fixes: eliminate R bridge command injection (static R script + argv), raise pyarrow>=17.0/lxml>=6.0 for CVEs, narrow lossless claims, make env install opt-in, stop scanning jamovi embedded JSON

v1.8.2: fix 6 reader/writer bugs (R crash, encoding detection, SAS special_missing, HDF5 dataset selection, Excel warnings/XPT value labels/Excel label round-trip), narrow ClawHub audit triggers, repo hygiene

statdata-transfer 1.7.6

- Major cleanup: documentation, reference, script, and test files were removed, leaving only SKILL.md.
- Reduced repository to core metadata file (SKILL.md); no code or usage examples bundled.
- README, LICENSE, requirements, assets, and test documentation no longer included in the skill package.

statdata-transfer 1.7.5

- Updated descriptions in SKILL.md and README files for greater clarity and conciseness on supported formats and bidirectional metadata preservation.
- Enhanced trigger phrases and table details to better reflect use cases and format capabilities.
- No code changes; documentation only.

statdata-transfer v1.7.4

- Updated documentation for clarity, conciseness, and consistency across README.md, README_ZH.md, and SKILL.md
- Reformatted and translated the Supported Formats & Capability Matrix to improve readability
- No functional changes to the core scripts (reader_core.py, reader_sas.py, reader_spss.py, reader_stata.py) logic detected; only doc and metadata updates
- Increased skill metadata version to 1.8.0 to reflect documentation improvements

statdata-transfer 1.7.3

- Added openclaw "icon" field to metadata (SKILL.md).
- Documentation updates to README.md, README_ZH.md, and metadata section.
- No functional/API changes; update is documentation and metadata only.

- Updated the logo (assets/logo.svg) for statdata-transfer.
- No changes to functionality or documentation content.

statdata-transfer 1.7.1

- No file changes detected; this is a version bump only.
- No user-facing feature, documentation, or metadata changes in this release.

- Added support for reading EpiInfo, ARFF (Weka), and Gretl formats, broadening compatibility with epidemiology, machine learning, and econometrics tools.
- Improved bidirectional conversion: now supports lossless, metadata-preserving conversions across 28+ statistical and data science formats.
- Enhanced metadata management: all variable/value labels, special missings, and custom metadata preserved for SPSS, Stata, SAS, R, and compatible formats.
- Conversion process now issues detailed, automatic warnings whenever metadata loss may occur.
- Updated documentation with comprehensive capability tables, use cases, and fallback rules for metadata handling.
